d.d: A minor official—usually overseeing a village or town—in many Arab countries and (historical) in the Ottoman Empire and its successor states, including Turkey, Northern Cyprus, and formerly Albania.
Alternative spelling of muhtar: an elected official overseeing a village or neighborhood in modern Turkey.
A person acting as an agent, particularly a lawyer.
Feminine synonym of masculine substantive noun मोक्ष (mokṣa, “liberation”).
